$comment: The desktop Companion installer the Techstack Windows installer carries (platform-pqq2ai, owner order 2026-11-14): kombify's own per-user MSI, read by the release job from its pinned prerelease (companion-desktop-v<version>) with a short-lived read-only token, verified by size and sha256 when it is staged (scripts/package-windows-client.ps1) and again by the client right before it runs msiexec. The client installs it only when a person switches the Companion on in Settings and none is installed. This is the one place that names the version, size and digest: a new Companion version changes only this file.
